description: Phantom drain analysis: how much range is lost between drives, why, and when. Part of Teslamate Ecos custom dashboards.

panels.description: Average range lost per day. Only gaps 30min–7 days. Zero-loss days included.

targets.rawSql: WITH drive_gaps AS (SELECT d.start_date, d.end_date, convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range, LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours, d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS end_range_km, LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range_km FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL) SELECT ROUND(AVG(loss)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Daily Loss ['$length_unit']" FROM (SELECT end_date::date AS day, SUM(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0)) AS loss FROM drive_gaps WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL AND end_range > next_start_range AND gap_hours > 0.5 AND gap_hours < 168 GROUP BY 1) AS daily

targets.rawSql: WITH drive_gaps AS (SELECT d.start_date, d.end_date, convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range, LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours, d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS end_range_km, LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range_km FROM drives d WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date) AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL) SELECT CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM end_date) WHEN 0 THEN 'Sun' WHEN 1 THEN 'Mon' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tue' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thu' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fri' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sat' END AS "Day", ROUND(AVG(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0))::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Loss ['$length_unit']" FROM drive_gaps WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL AND end_range > next_start_range AND gap_hours > 0.5 AND gap_hours < 168 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM end_date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM end_date)

panels.description: Average hourly drain rate by outside temperature. Cold-to-hot color gradient (blue→green→red). Both cold and hot extremes increase phantom drain.

targets.rawSql:
WITH drive_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    d.start_date,
    convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range,
    LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours,
    LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_outside_temp
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 0 THEN '<0°C'
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 5 THEN '0-5°C'
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 10 THEN '5-10°C'
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 15 THEN '10-15°C'
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 20 THEN '15-20°C'
    WHEN next_outside_temp < 25 THEN '20-25°C'
    ELSE '25°C+'
  END AS "Temperature",
  ROUND(AVG(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0) / NULLIF(gap_hours, 0))::numeric, 3) AS "Drain Rate",
  COUNT(*)::int AS "Events"
FROM drive_gaps
WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL
  AND end_range > next_start_range
  AND gap_hours > 0.5
  AND gap_hours < 168
  AND next_outside_temp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(next_outside_temp)

Worst Drain Days
panels.description: Top 20 days with highest phantom drain. Shows date, range lost, park duration, hourly rate, and temperature.

targets.rawSql:
WITH drive_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    d.start_date,
    d.end_date,
    convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range,
    LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours,
    d.outside_temp_avg
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  DATE(start_date) AS "Date",
  ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Range Lost [$length_unit]",
  ROUND(AVG(gap_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Park Hours [h]",
  ROUND((SUM(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0)) / NULLIF(AVG(gap_hours), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Hourly Rate [$length_unit/h]",
  ROUND(AVG(outside_temp_avg)::numeric, 1) AS "Temp [°C]"
FROM drive_gaps
WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL
  AND end_range > next_start_range
  AND gap_hours > 0.5
  AND gap_hours < 168
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Range Lost [$length_unit]" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Drain Rate by Vehicle State
panels.description: Average hourly drain rate when car is in each state. Shows which state causes the most drain (online/Sentry Mode vs asleep).

targets.rawSql:
WITH drive_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    d.start_date,
    d.end_date,
    convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range,
    LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
),
gap_with_state AS (
  SELECT 
    dg.gap_hours,
    GREATEST(dg.end_range - dg.next_start_range, 0) AS range_loss,
    (SELECT s.state::text FROM states s 
     WHERE s.car_id = $car_id 
       AND s.start_date <= dg.start_date 
       AND (s.end_date IS NULL OR s.end_date >= dg.start_date)
     ORDER BY s.start_date DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS state
  FROM drive_gaps dg
  WHERE dg.next_start_range IS NOT NULL
    AND dg.end_range > dg.next_start_range
    AND dg.gap_hours > 0.5
    AND dg.gap_hours < 168
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(state, 'unknown') AS "State",
  ROUND(AVG(range_loss / NULLIF(gap_hours, 0))::numeric, 3) AS "Avg Hourly Drain",
  COUNT(*) AS "Events"
FROM gap_with_state
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "Avg Hourly Drain" DESC

panels.title: Drain vs Park Duration
panels.description: Average drain by parking duration range. Shows how drain increases with longer parking periods.

targets.rawSql:
WITH drive_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    d.start_date,
    convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range,
    LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  CASE
    WHEN gap_hours < 1 THEN '<1 hour'
    WHEN gap_hours < 3 THEN '1-3 hours'
    WHEN gap_hours < 6 THEN '3-6 hours'
    WHEN gap_hours < 12 THEN '6-12 hours'
    WHEN gap_hours < 24 THEN '12-24 hours'
    ELSE '>24 hours'
  END AS "Duration",
  ROUND(AVG(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0))::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Drain",
  COUNT(*) AS "Events"
FROM drive_gaps
WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL
  AND end_range > next_start_range
  AND gap_hours > 0.5
  AND gap_hours < 168
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly Drain Trend
panels.description: Monthly total range lost with 3-month moving average. Shows seasonal patterns.

targets.rawSql:
WITH drive_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    d.start_date,
    convert_km(d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit') AS end_range,
    LEAD(convert_km(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km, '$length_unit')) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) AS next_start_range,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAD(d.start_date) OVER (ORDER BY d.start_date) - d.end_date)) / 3600 AS gap_hours
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(d.start_date)
    AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
    AND d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km IS NOT NULL
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', start_date) AS month,
    SUM(GREATEST(end_range - next_start_range, 0)) AS total_loss
  FROM drive_gaps
  WHERE next_start_range IS NOT NULL
    AND end_range > next_start_range
    AND gap_hours > 0.5
    AND gap_hours < 168
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  month AS time,
  total_loss AS "Monthly Loss",
  AVG(total_loss) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "3-Month Avg"
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

panels.title: Sentry Mode Impact
panels.description: Estimated drain during Sentry Mode events (frequent online/offline cycles < 5 min)

targets.rawSql:
WITH sentry_events AS (
  SELECT 
    start_date,
    end_date,
    state,
    LEAD(state) OVER (ORDER BY start_date) AS next_state,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date)) AS duration_sec
  FROM states
  WHERE car_id = $car_id
    AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS "Sentry Events",
  ROUND(SUM(duration_sec) / 3600::numeric, 1) AS "Total Hours"
FROM sentry_events
WHERE state = 'online' 
  AND next_state = 'offline'
  AND duration_sec < 300
